messages:
Priya (Product): quick sync — we have two customers (Acme, Nova) pushing for ModelServe v2 features: model pinning + better tail latency. Target: alpha in ~6w. Need alignment on launch criteria, must-have vs nice-to-have, and cross-team blockers. who can triage? @here
Lucas (Eng): I can. quick clarifying q: what are the exact latency numbers they expect? 95th percentile or p99?
Priya (Product): 95th primarily. goal is <200ms for short prompts (~32 tokens). p99 is less strict for alpha. Also enterprise customers want model pinning & audit trail.
Maya (Runtime): FYI: current KV cache + batching gets us ~220ms on our p3 config with current kernels. to hit <200 we'd need either kernel improvements or 4-bit quantization + faster dispatch. model pinning also needs router changes for sticky routing & versioned artifacts.
Owen (Infra): reserving dedicated capacity is doable but requires +4 GPUs on the Dedicated pool for the alpha region. cost estimate + runbook change for autoscale. timeline-wise reserving takes ~1 week approval from finance.
Rae (Security): model pinning + audit logs are ok from a security POV. for Private customers using KMS we need a key provisioning flow and an extra config flag. low-medium effort but needs testing for rotation.
Diego (SRE): rollout/rollback SLOs? We should define canary->bulk and an automatic fallback to hosted smaller model if the 95th spikes. Also tracing hooks for token-level latencies.
Priya (Product): thanks. proposal: for alpha we scope to API + model pinning + 95th <200ms on dedicated infra in one region. Defer: full A/B evaluation UI, extensive devex docs, and multi-region. Does that feel acceptable?
Lucas (Eng): fine if we can guarantee the latency path. if runtime can do quantization or kernel tweak before alpha. otherwise we need to lower the target or add more GPUs which is costy.
Maya (Runtime): I can do an optimization sprint: 2 weeks to validate int4 quantization on the model family and ~1 week for kernel hotfixes if we prioritize. risk: quality regressions; need eval set from Product.
Priya (Product): we'll provide the eval prompts and regression thresholds. tradeoff: if quantization causes >2% regression on our quality metric we hold off.
Owen (Infra): timeline check: finance approval + provisioning ~1 week, infra changes + config ~3 days, staging setup for dedicated pool ~2 days. total ~2 weeks if approvals are fast.
Rae (Security): I'll draft the KMS flow and audit requirements. need a short review cycle (2 business days) from infra and legal.
Diego (SRE): I'll wire tracing + canary. estimate 3-4 days to add token-level traces and alerting for latency regressions.
Priya (Product): ok action list — please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept ownership and ETA.
Priya (Product): ACTIONS:
```
- Maya: validate INT4 quantization + perf numbers (ETA 2w)
- Lucas: implement router changes for model pinning + fallback logic (ETA 1w after Maya validation)
- Owen: reserve Dedicated GPUs and prepare staging pool (ETA 2w)
- Rae: KMS + audit flow doc (ETA 4 business days)
- Diego: tracing + canary pipeline (ETA 4 business days)
- Priya: provide eval prompts + success thresholds (ETA 2d)
```
Lucas (Eng): :white_check_mark: taking router work, will pair with Maya once quant results are in.
Maya (Runtime): :white_check_mark: starting perf validation tomorrow. will post preliminary numbers in this thread.
Owen (Infra): :white_check_mark: I'll kick off the procurement approval today.
Rae (Security): :white_check_mark: will drop doc link when ready.
Diego (SRE): :white_check_mark: will add tracing PR and canary config.
Priya (Product): thanks team. let's reconvene in 4 business days unless blockers emerge. booking a 30m triage Fri 9:30am to review quant results and go/no-go.
Lucas (Eng): noted. if numbers look close to target we may need a temporary extra GPU to hit 95th for alpha — we should budget that as contingency.
Priya (Product): noted — i'll include a cost contingency in the procurement ticket. :+1:
